title: Tenant Usage Response
description: Read-only account balance returned by GET /recognition/tenant/usage (tenant API key) and GET /portal/usage (portal session). Both routes share one builder, so the bodies are identical for the same tenant. A count is null when the accounting authority cannot supply it; consumers must show it as unavailable and must not derive a substitute.

tenant_id.description: Tenant bound to the presented credential. Never selected by a client header.

used.description: Committed jobs in the current period.

reserved.description: Jobs admitted but not yet settled. Null when the read source has no reservation split.

remaining.description: Jobs still available this period. Null when allowance or used is unavailable.

allowance.description: Jobs granted for the current period.

period_start.description: Inclusive start of the entitlement period (UTC).

period_end.description: Exclusive end of the entitlement period (UTC).

period.description: The same period as period_start/period_end, grouped.

as_of.description: When the read source observed these counts. Null when the source does not report it.

status.description: Entitlement status, or null when the read source does not report a known status.

data_source.description: Provenance of the counts, e.g. authoritative or pending.
